M17_rebuild_reason_order_swapped._note: review r2 L-B (G7) — the pre-#4277 order: a NEW TBox label wins over a previous one, so a TBox→TBox rename says 'changed', not 'lost'. The order is observable ONLY when BOTH probes fire (T3 / T14 / T11 / T16); T4's two cases (lost: hadLabel only; gained: newLabel only) each fire one probe and read the same string in either order — the reviewer's G7 → T4 assignment was the wrong axis, T4 cannot see the swap by construction (driver run 2026-09-19: red = T3 T11 T14 T16).

M18_buildInternal_always_materialises_(i._note: review r2 L-B (G9a) — `index` (buildCacheWithValidation) must stay layer-less: it materialises its own layer afterwards via saveInferredTriples.

M19_explicitCount_taken_after_the_concat._note: review r2 L-B (G9c) — the #4272 boundary: explicitCount is the EXPLICIT count even when the rebuild returns explicit + inferred.

M20_projection_takes_the_LITERAL_label_t._note: review r3 LOW (G5b) — the projection's label component is IRI-only: a HUMAN label is not what a referrer emits (it emits the file-IRI), so editing it must stay a delta. With the literal in the projection T18's rename becomes a rebuild.

M21_projection_takes_LITERAL_aliases_too._note: review r3 LOW (G5c) — the projection's alias component is the TBox-form (IRI) alias SET only; literal aliases belong to the ordinary alias diff (needle re-parse). With literals in the projection T19's added literal alias becomes a rebuild instead of a 2-file delta — and T5's second step (the same TBox set reordered + a human alias appended, expected delta) rebuilds for the same reason; the two axes share the guard, not a fixture (driver: RED = [T19, T5]).
